stages.headline: A tetrahedron is a solid with 4 triangular faces, 6 edges and 4 vertices.
stages.headlineEnglish: A tetrahedron is a solid with 4 triangular faces, 6 edges and 4 vertices.

stages.headline: Faces are triangles ABC, ABD, ACD, BCD; edges AB, AC, AD, BC, BD, CD; hidden edges are dashed.
stages.headlineEnglish: Faces are triangles ABC, ABD, ACD, BCD; edges AB, AC, AD, BC, BD, CD; hidden edges are dashed.

stages.headline: If all edges are equal the tetrahedron is regular and all faces are equilateral; it is also called a triangular pyramid.
stages.headlineEnglish: If all edges are equal the tetrahedron is regular and all faces are equilateral; it is also called a triangular pyramid.
